tests.prompt: Call resolveDungeonSpec(DungeonKeyCrypt, seed) directly (white-box). Verify the returned tkenc.DungeonParams equals calling tkenc.CryptDungeonParams(seed, cryptDoorEntranceToCorridor, cryptDoorCorridorToBoss) directly -- rpg-api owns no region width/height/theme/obstacle literal of its own for the crypt key any more.

Call resolveDungeonSpec with the zero-value DungeonKey and a given seed. Verify it resolves to DungeonKeyCrypt and returns the exact same tkenc.DungeonParams as an explicit DungeonKeyCrypt call with the same seed.

Call resolveDungeonSpec(DungeonKeyCrypt, seed) with two different seeds. Verify the returned params.RandomSeed matches each input seed and the two results differ -- a builder that silently ignored its seed argument would fail this.

StartEncounter with the crypt key and an explicit seed. Verify the persisted Space has exactly 3 regions tagged entrance/corridor/boss (RegionData.Archetype), Space.Theme == 'crypt', Space.Height and each region's bounding width match a live tkenc.CryptDungeonParams call with the same seed (never a hardcoded literal), and the boss region's primary playable axis (min(width, height)) exceeds 6 hex steps.
StartEncounter with the crypt key. Verify every seated party member's spawn hex is tagged into the entrance-archetype region, and the first member spawns exactly at Space.Entrance.

A real StartEncounter call with the crypt key and an explicit (known-good) seed. Verify SpaceData.Obstacles is non-empty, every obstacle ID is unique, and grouped by the region archetype it's placed in: entrance has exactly 1 obelisk + 2 pillars, corridor has exactly 1 pillar, boss has exactly 1 coffin + 1 altar + 1 statue-reaper + 1 statue-knight-hooded -- refs read off the toolkit's exported CryptObstacleRef* constants, never a string this package invents. Also verify the blocking-flag table (every ref BlocksMovement=true; every ref BlocksLoS=true EXCEPT the coffin, which is false).
Start two independent encounters with the crypt key and the same explicit seed (different lobbies/players). Verify their persisted SpaceData.Obstacles lists are non-empty and byte-identical.

Start two independent encounters with the same explicit RandomSeed and the crypt key. Verify their persisted Space (walls, width/height, entrance, regions, obstacles) and connector door positions are byte-identical.

Call StartEncounter with a DungeonKey that has no registered spec. Verify it returns an error (ErrUnknownDungeonKey), wraps a resolveDungeonSpec(key, seed) call that also errors directly, and does not create or persist an encounter or transition the lobby out of WAITING.

Start two encounters with the same key+seed but different party sizes (1 vs 2 members). Verify persisted Space and connector door positions are byte-identical -- InitDungeon runs before any AddPlayer call and takes no party information as input.

StartEncounter with the crypt key and a known-good seed. Verify exactly 2 goblins land in the entrance region and 2 in the boss region, none in the corridor, at distinct positions, combat does not start at spawn, and moving a player onto an entrance-region goblin's hex flips the encounter to TURN_BASED by the toolkit's own rule.

Bump go.mod's rpg-toolkit/encounter requirement to the published v0.38.0 tag (verified on the real Go module proxy, containing rpg-toolkit#826's CryptDungeonParams) via `go get` + `go mod tidy`. Verify the resulting go.mod/go.sum diff is a single version-line change with no replace directive, no go.work, and no unrelated transitive version drift.

Revert dungeon_spec.go's DungeonKeyCrypt builder to a version that forces every region's Obstacles field to nil (simulating the pre-#694 API-owned-literal shape) while leaving the new obstacle tests unchanged. Verify TestStartEncounter_CryptObstacles_ExactRefsCountsAndBlockingByRegion fails (SpaceData.Obstacles is empty). Restore the real tkenc.CryptDungeonParams-backed builder and verify the test passes again.

Run the full internal/handlers/dnd5e/v2/encounter test package and the real-Redis DungeonCryptSuite (rpg-api#687/#695's zone/theme wire projection). Verify every pre-existing test still passes unmodified -- Space.zones/theme/Hex.zone_id projection reads off Space.Regions/Theme however InitDungeon populates them, independent of whether Obstacles is set.

Sweep StartEncounter with the crypt key across many explicit RandomSeed values (1..1000) for party sizes 1/2/3/4, using the real spatial/spawn/perception packages (no test doubles). Measure and record the failure rate ('spawn engine failed to place N of 4 goblin(s)') by party size. Confirm the failure is deterministic per seed (repeated sweeps produce identical results), and confirm it is NOT present on origin/main (0/30 baseline runs of a pre-existing entropy-seeded test). File the finding as a new rpg-api issue with full evidence; do not attempt to fix it in this branch (out of #694's stated scope).
